title: lotus corniculatus f. glaber
intro: Lotus corniculatus f. glaber, commonly known as the lesser knapweed or smooth meadow knapweed, is a perennial plant belonging to the family Fabaceae. The plant is known to offer various health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Lotus corniculatus f. glaber include its potential to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, as well as its ability to exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
